scope: Independent whole-object semantic and identity review of the exact frozen v1 proposal only; not N07 cross-unit or implementation acceptance.

findings.finding: Every keyed option is strictly longer than all four distractors. This is a repeated correct-answer form cue independent of the scenario decision.
findings.requiredCorrection: Replace the distractors with credible, complete competing policies whose specific boundary failure is grounded in each prompt; do not pad or remove options. Preserve the keyed decision meaning and update diagnostics only when option meaning changes.
findings.notARequirement: No equal-word-count, maximum-length, option-count, or zero-warning quota.

findings.finding: The full-load/filter-by-team distractor can satisfy the visible query/mapping requirements for a small bounded dataset; the prompt states no volume/selectivity requirement, but Details call the work unbounded.
findings.requiredCorrection: Make the data/query constraint that rules this approach out visible, or replace it with a clearly contract-violating alternative.

cohortAssessment: The repeated repository/collection boundary is legitimate practice for the declared unit objective because each item tests a different visible invariant, query, identity, storage mapping, or freshness/order discriminator. No unique-concept quota is imposed. The repeated correct-option length cue is independently blocking under §4.3.
